queries.query: My agent needs to discover metric names and run PromQL queries for both the current value and a time range. Which MCP server can connect to our monitoring endpoint?
我的 Agent 需要查看有哪些监控指标，再用 PromQL 查询当前值和一段时间内的数据。什么 MCP 服务能连接我们的监控系统？
Which MCP tool can run my Postman collection with an environment file and tell my coding agent which API tests failed?
哪个 MCP 工具能用指定的环境文件运行我的 Postman 集合，并告诉代码 Agent 哪些接口测试失败了？
I have a Figma frame link. What MCP integration can give my coding agent the layout and styling data so it can implement the screen?
我有一个 Figma 画框链接，想让代码 Agent 读取布局和样式数据来实现这个界面，应该接哪个 MCP？
I want my assistant to check which smart-home lights are on and switch them off through my home automation hub. What MCP connection supports that?
我想让助手通过家里的智能家居中枢查看哪些灯还亮着，并把它们关掉。什么 MCP 连接能做到？
I want to turn a written dialogue into an audio file, preferably with a different voice for each speaker. Which MCP tool could help?
我想把一段对话稿做成音频文件，最好每个角色用不同的声音。有什么 MCP 工具能帮忙？
Is there a dedicated Strava MCP server here that lists my recent rides and reads their GPS tracks? I need built-in tools, without browser automation, shell commands or a generic API adapter.
这个目录里有专门对接 Strava 的 MCP 服务，能列出我最近的骑行记录并读取 GPS 轨迹吗？需要现成工具，不用浏览器自动化、命令行或通用 API 适配器。
